summary: Frontend-only visual verification of MY DREAM PROJECTS office image swap. Verified all 3 surfaces on desktop (1920) and mobile (390) render the NEW night exterior (lit signage, Range Rover, landscaped path) and NEW interior (desk + wall logo). verification_details.old_imagery_check: No daytime container exterior or old interior detected on any of the 3 surfaces. All show new night imagery.
verification_details.http_status: All 5 files served with HTTP 200 to browser (naturalWidth > 0, complete=true, images visible). Note: server returns 403 to HEAD requests from python urllib (bot detection); real browser GETs succeed.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: About.jsx line 303 srcSet declares '/assets/office/office-interior.webp 1672w' but actual encoded file natural width from -800 variant is 729w; the fallback 1672w descriptor should match the actual encoded native width. Not a functional issue.
Note: office-exterior.webp and office-exterior-1600.webp are byte-identical (448676 bytes each). This is fine as the srcSet uses -1600 for 1448w, but they are redundant duplicates on disk.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Office image swap fully verified. If task involves image assets served via HEAD, note that the preview edge returns 403 to non-browser UA (urllib) but browser GET works fine.
